summary: Tested StyleScan Claude Sonnet 5 chat integration end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests passed covering create/list/messages/soft-delete conversations, SSE streaming with claude-sonnet-5, multi-turn context retention, first-message title auto-set, 404s for non-existent ids, and empty-message rejection. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): empty state renders hero + 4 suggestion chips; tapping a chip creates a conversation, streams the reply token-by-token (~1345 chars accumulated with no dropped characters), and **bold** markdown is rendered as bold (no raw ** markers). Composer send works for multi-turn (2 user + 2 assistant bubbles). History screen lists saved conversations; tapping a row reopens the conversation with full message history restored (8 messages loaded). New-chat button clears state and returns to empty. Delete removes the row from the list (7 -> 6). No red-screen errors and no console errors observed.

issues: Assistant replies sometimes include markdown headings ('## Heading') and horizontal rules ('---') which render as literal text since only **bold** is parsed. Consider expanding renderInline() or steering the system prompt to avoid # / --- syntax for a cleaner mobile read.

action_items: (Optional) Expand markdown rendering in MessageBubble to handle headings (#, ##) and horizontal rules, OR tighten the STYLIST_SYSTEM_PROMPT to discourage those tokens so replies read cleaner on mobile.
(Optional, low priority) FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated; migrate to a lifespan context manager.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py properly excludes MongoDB _id via clean(); all ids are UUID strings.
Backend uses async motor throughout; SSE StreamingResponse sets Cache-Control and X-Accel-Buffering correctly for token streaming.
Frontend api.ts XHR SSE parser correctly tracks a `consumed` offset and only appends the new tail — the earlier dropped-character bug is fixed and verified live.
All interactive elements have testID; touch targets are >=44x44.
seed_data_creation: Tests created & then soft-deleted transient conversations; a few remained in DB from streaming tests (expected persistence).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_stylescan_chat.py exercises SSE by streaming with requests.iter_content and parsing 'data: {...}\n\n' frames — reuse the _stream_chat helper for future chat tests. On the web preview, Expo Router keeps the previous screen mounted under the new one, so [data-testid="new-chat-button"] can match 2 nodes after navigating from /history; use ':visible' or .last to target the active screen.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no regressions found. All 10 listed features in the review request behave correctly.
